mapper.select: select * from sys_user where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select * from sys_user where user_no = #{userNo} and deleted = 0

select * from sys_user where email = #{email} and deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( department_id, password, real_name, user_no, gender, phone, email, credit_score, violation_count, normal_reservation_streak, status, deleted ) values( #{departmentId}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{userNo}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{creditScore}, #{violationCount}, #{normalReservationStreak}, #{status}, 0 )
mapper.update: update sys_user set department_id = #{departmentId}, real_name = #{realName}, user_no = #{userNo}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, status = #{status} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
